The Intel AFBR-709DMZ-IN2 10GBASE-SR SFP+ Transceiver is a high-performance 10 Gigabit optical module designed for reliable and ultra-fast fiber networking applications. Built for enterprise networking, servers, switches, and data center infrastructure, this SFP+ transceiver delivers stable 10Gbps data transmission with excellent compatibility and low power consumption.


Featuring an LC duplex connector and operating at an 850nm wavelength, the Intel AFBR-709DMZ-IN2 supports multimode fiber (MMF) connections with transmission distances up to 300 meters using OM3 fiber cable. Its hot-pluggable SFP+ form factor allows quick installation and easy maintenance without interrupting network operations.


This 10GBASE-SR optical transceiver is an ideal solution for high-speed Ethernet environments, cloud infrastructure, storage networking, and enterprise fiber deployments in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Supports 10Gbps 10GBASE-SR Ethernet connectivity
  • Genuine Intel AFBR-709DMZ-IN2 transceiver
  • SFP+ hot-swappable form factor
  • LC duplex optical connector
  • 850nm wavelength for multimode fiber
  • Up to 300m transmission distance on OM3 MMF
  • Low power consumption and high reliability
  • Compatible with Intel servers, switches, and NICs
